race.comment: BOURNE LEGACY (8) made progress as a late-season juvenile and resumes off the back of a couple of really strong jump-out efforts. The blinkers are off, and he should go close to taking this out. CIPHERED (9) resumes from a spell as a gelding, and he has improved in each of his tune-up jump-outs. He maps to receive the run of the race from the pole position, and he is a top 4 player this time. COUNT CHEVALIER (10) hit the line strongly late at Swan Hill 4 weeks ago, and if the gaps come at the right time, he can run into the money again. VELVET REIGN (13) makes her debut with plenty of experience at the jump-outs under her belt. She is bred to want more ground than this, but any market confidence will be worth following up. MERRY CHASE (11) is on debut, and he looks to have plenty to offer. Keep him safe in all combos.
